question:
Select the pair that follows the same pattern as that followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

BCG−FGK

WXB−ABF
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d64ff912e448709a8d2fedda12c3fc82283c0ef7f2b868d9139e58826496405.png] Logic followed here is: The second group of letters is obtained by adding 4 to the positional value of each letter in the first group of letters. **BCG is related to FGK →**
